sources.title: Native Windows existing-proxy recovery and metadata-only verification
claims: A stopped loopback proxy was restored through its existing launcher
Health 200, no-key 401 and authenticated model metadata 200
Static catalog refreshed from 11 to 13 eligible entries and loaded by the actual extension app-server
sources.note: Sanitized observation of copilot-proxy-api 0.10.32, Node 26.13.0, PowerShell 7.6.10, VS Code 1.147.0, extension 26.1007.21434 and bundled Codex 0.162.0-alpha.17.2. The original process disappearance was not explained. No inference, GUI, restart/logout test or new account authorization was performed. Raw paths, backups, logs and credentials remain outside this repository.

sources.title: Windows maintenance regression checks and blocked locked dependency installation
claims: 17 repository tests passed on Windows x64 with Node 26.13.0
CRLF-only normalization restored all four original Linux material hashes without changing their evidence
Windows ACL checks reject unrelated principals
A directory junction tests resource escape without elevated symlink rights
The selected npm CLI is invoked through Node
sources.note: The clean locked install failed with HTTP 404 from the configured mirror for pkce-challenge 5.0.2; the official registry also failed TLS negotiation through Node and Windows curl. The pinned gateway's four original tests were not run on this machine. No TLS bypass, version substitution or registry configuration change was made.

claims: Windows .cmd files cannot be launched directly with execFile
sources.note: Verified against the v26.13.0 Node documentation source; the runner uses node plus npm_execpath rather than interpolating a shell command.
